## Fish Scale Analysis

Load the tidyverse and the dataset:

```{r}
library(tidyverse)

fish_data <- read_csv("../data/Gaeta_etal_CLC_data.csv")
```

View the dataset:

```{r}
head(fish_data)
```

Summary stats for the fish scale length:

```{r}
fish_data |>
  summarise(min_scale_length = min(scalelength, na.rm = T), 
            max_scale_length = max(scalelength, na.rm = T), 
          mean_scale_length = mean(scalelength, na.rm = T))
```

In the `fish_analysis.qmd` file, create a new data frame that does not include fish with scale lengths of less than 1 mm from `fish_data`:

```{r}
fish_data_filtered <- fish_data |>
  filter(scalelength >= 1)
nrow(fish_data_filtered)
write_csv(fish_data_filtered, "../data/fish_data_filtered.csv")
```
